responsibility: This header defines the sreal class, GCC’s compact approximate real-number abstraction. It specifies the normalized significand/exponent representation and bounds, inline normalization and shifting logic, arithmetic and comparison operators, min/max constructors, and streaming/debug declarations. It is the interface and hot-path implementation for a simple finite real type used by middle-end analyses and summaries that need inexpensive real-valued arithmetic without full REAL_VALUE_TYPE support.
same_name_distinction: This .h file defines the sreal class representation, constants, comparisons, shifts, and inline normalization helpers, while gcc/sreal.cc implements the non-inline arithmetic, conversions, dumping, serialization, and selftests.
